item.title: Lee Hae-in Challenged Her Three-Year Ban And Returned
item.description: South Korean figure skater Lee Hae-in denied allegations of sexually harassing a younger teammate, saying they were dating. A court paused her three-year ban in November 2024, finding the conduct did not constitute harassment. The skating federation lifted the ban in May 2025.

item.title: He Kept Picking Up Uber Passengers Between Shootings
item.description: In February 2016, Uber driver Jason Dalton killed six people and wounded two around Kalamazoo, Michigan, while continuing to collect passengers between attacks. He pleaded guilty to murder and attempted murder in 2019 and was sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: Randy Stair Posted His Plan Before The Supermarket Shootings
item.description: In June 2017, supermarket employee Randy Stair killed three coworkers at a Weis Market in Pennsylvania before taking his own life. Investigators uncovered videos and writings, including a recording posted shortly before the attack that described his plans.

item.title: Stephanie Melgoza Asked For Her Car After Fatal Crash
item.description: After a 2022 DUI crash killed Andrea Rosewicz and Paul Prowant in East Peoria, Illinois, bodycam footage showed Stephanie Melgoza asking when she could get her car back. She pleaded guilty to aggravated DUI and aggravated reckless driving and received 14 years in prison in 2023.

item.title: The Disputed Name At The Heart Of Jessica Chambers’s Case
item.description: Jessica Chambers, 19, died after being set on fire in Mississippi in 2014. Responders testified they heard her name “Eric,” but prosecutors disputed whether she could speak clearly. Quinton Tellis’s two murder trials ended in hung juries; no one has been convicted of her killing.

item.title: Rescuers Drilled A Second Shaft To Reach Baby Jessica
item.description: In October 1987, 18-month-old Jessica McClure fell into a narrow well in Midland, Texas. Trapped 22 feet underground, she survived for 58 hours as crews drilled a parallel shaft and tunneled through rock to bring her out alive.

item.title: Hang Mioku Turned To Cooking Oil After Silicone Ran Out
item.description: South Korean woman Hang Mioku said she injected cooking oil into her face after running out of silicone, causing lasting damage. Television coverage prompted donations for corrective surgery, but repeated operations could only partially repair the harm.
